verdict.line: You lose if you let her farm Q pokes and reset E (Skip 'n Slash) to kite for free; you win by landing W (Infernal Chains) and forcing an extended fight before she can back off.

brief.thesis: This is a fight-duration matchup: Gwen wants short trades where her Q (Snip Snip!) true-damage center hit and A Thousand Cuts passive chip you down and heal her, while Aatrox wants long trades where Umbral Dash's on-damage heal and a Deathbringer Stance proc out-heal her passive. The 50.9% win rate over 572 games with Aatrox holding both lane and solo-kill advantage reflects that Aatrox can win this if he drags her into extended melee before her Hallowed Mist (W) or Skip 'n Slash (E) let her disengage.

theirWindow.when: Her W and E are both up
theirWindow.what: She can wall off your engage with Hallowed Mist (untargetable outside the mist, cooldown 22-18s) and kite with Skip 'n Slash's attack speed/range window. Don't force Infernal Chains into a mist she just dropped — back off and reset the wave instead of feeding her free Q true-damage pokes.

yourWindow.when: Her Hallowed Mist is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is when to commit. Land W (Infernal Chains, 825 range) to drag her to the impact center, then chain Q (The Darkin Blade) swings and Umbral Dash (E) to re-engage — the E passive heals you on every hit landed, so the longer the fight runs the more it favors you.

start.why: Highest pick rate (67.6%) and win rate (51.6%) start; the extra sustain and AD matter since you want to win extended trades, not short pokes.

boots.why: Measured 56.5% win rate here despite lower pick rate. Gwen's passive (A Thousand Cuts) and E on-hit both scale off her autos, so flat auto-attack reduction directly cuts her sustain and poke.

core.why: The shield-and-burst proc rewards the all-in you're forcing with W (Infernal Chains); best-measured path into this matchup at 52.9% win rate.
Crit-triggered healing stacks with Umbral Dash's on-damage heal, letting you win the exact prolonged fight this matchup is decided by.
Damage-over-time conversion smooths out her Q true-damage pokes and R (Needlework) chip, so you arrive at your all-in window at full effective health.

situational.when: she rushes burst magic damage and you need the shield plus magic resist to survive to your all-in window
she keeps resetting Skip 'n Slash to kite and you need a slow proc to stick a full combo on her
you're already ahead and want to chain W into Q into E faster to punish her before Hallowed Mist comes back up

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks build during the exact extended-fight pattern you're forcing with Infernal Chains and repeated Q swings; the healing on full stacks compounds with Umbral Dash's on-damage heal to outlast A Thousand Cuts.

summoners.why: Highest measured pick (77.8%) and win rate (51.9%) combo, and it matches your solo-kill advantage in this matchup — Ignite closes out all-ins before her passive heal or E kiting lets her reset.

playing.title: Press levels 3-5 hard
playing.detail: Aatrox holds solo-kill advantage here before Gwen's Hallowed Mist comes online at 6. Land W (Infernal Chains, 20-16s cooldown at these ranks) and follow immediately with Q and E to punish her before she has a reliable disengage.

playing.title: Stay outside 450 when not trading
playing.detail: Snip Snip! is a cone up to 6 snips with true damage on the center hit and a short 6.5-3.5s cooldown. Standing at the edge of that range lets her poke you for free between your W windows.

playing.title: Only all-in on a Deathbringer Stance proc
playing.detail: Check your passive icon before committing — the bonus magic damage and heal on your empowered auto swings the extended fight further in your favor against her sustain.

playing.title: Respect Needlework after level 6
playing.detail: Her R throws a slowing needle with up to two extra casts and applies A Thousand Cuts on hit at 1200 range. Don't walk minion waves down in a straight line where all three casts can connect.

playing.title: Bait Hallowed Mist before committing
playing.detail: If she drops W preemptively, disengage and wait out its 22-18s cooldown rather than fighting into it — Infernal Chains against a Gwen inside her own mist wastes your cooldown for nothing.

playing.title: Time all-ins to Eclipse/Sundered Sky spike
playing.detail: Levels 9-13 with those two items online is your strongest window to force fights; the shield and healing proc directly counter her poke-and-kite pattern.

brief.patchCaveat: Win rates, item paths, runes, and summoner picks above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.18.1); the trade-pattern and timing analysis is my own read of the ability kits.
